title: Monitor, core dumps, and production readiness

questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “Monitor, core dumps, and production readiness”?
options: Build size and logs help identify resource problems before deployment.
ESP32 family members do not all have the same radios and peripherals.
ESP-IDF selects the chip target before building.
The ESP32 name alone does not guarantee pin or radio compatibility; check the exact part.
questions.answer: Build size and logs help identify resource problems before deployment.
questions.explanation:
Build size and logs help identify resource problems before deployment.
Why: The serial monitor exposes boot logs, error codes, and build information. Document firmware versions, reset reasons, crash capture, log levels, and recovery for production.

`idf.py monitor` and `idf.py size` are ESP-IDF tools. For Arduino-ESP32, build and open the serial monitor with Arduino IDE or Arduino CLI; the additional example shows Arduino Serial diagnostics.
